summary: Biophytis SA, a French clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a strengthened cash position (EUR 3.0 million) and extended cash runway into Q1 2027. The update details warrant exercises (BSA 2026) generating EUR 2.5 million, drawdowns of EUR 1.2 million on a Hexagon bond facility, debt-to-equity conversions of EUR 1.37 million reducing financial debt to EUR 2.9 million, and an increase in shares outstanding to ~240 million. No M&A, tender, or other classic special situation is present; this is an ordinary liquidity update.
